errors.error_description: Declared a logic vector 'unused_flag' that is never read or driven anywhere in the module.
Drove the input port 'sel' internally using a continuous assignment.
Implemented a deeply nested if-else structure to select the mux input, creating a long combinational path.
Assigned a 16-bit signal 'y' to an 8-bit output 'y_narrow', causing silent truncation.
